source.author: verg
source.text: Esto nunc Sol testis et haec mihi Terra voeanti, quam propter tantos potui perferre labores, et pater omnipotens et tu Saturnia coniunx, iam melior, iam, diva, precor, tuque inclute Mavors, cuncta tuo qui bella, pater, sub numine torques; fontisque fluviosque voco, quaeque aetheris alti religio et quae caeruleo sunt numina ponto:
source.text_original: 'Esto nunc Sol testis et haec mihi Terra voeanti, / quam propter tantos potui perferre labores, / et pater omnipotens et tu Saturnia coniunx, / iam melior, iam, diva, precor, tuque inclute Mavors, / cuncta tuo qui bella, pater, sub numine torques; / fontisque fluviosque voco, quaeque aetheris alti / religio et quae caeruleo sunt numina ponto: /
source.text_english: Now let Sol be witness for me, and this Earth to my call, for whose sake I was able to endure so great labors, and Father almighty and you, Saturnian consort, now kinder, now, goddess, I pray, and you, glorious Mavors, father, who sway all wars beneath your power; I call on fountains and rivers, and the sacred power of high heaven and the deities that are in the blue sea:

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: non nuntia tantum fama refert: ipsum iuvenem tam saeva gementem, ipsum ego, cum serus fessos sopor alligat artus, aspicio; lacera assiduis namque illius umbra questibus et magni numen maris excitat Helle.
reuse.text_original: non nuntia tantum / fama refert: ipsum iuvenem tam saeva gementem, / ipsum ego, cum serus fessos sopor alligat artus, / aspicio; lacera assiduis namque illius umbra / questibus et magni numen maris excitat Helle.
reuse.text_english: Report does not bring only tidings: I myself behold the young man, groaning so fiercely, I myself, when late sleep binds weary limbs, do I see him; for Helle, torn by constant laments, and the divinity of the great sea, rouses his shade.
